vessel: 12 FL OZ (355mL) sleek crystal-clear PET beverage can

sans.name: Instrument Sans
sans.role: UI navigation, editorial body copy, cart & checkout controls

mono.name: Fragment Mono
mono.role: Pack counts, pricing, volume specs (always tabular-nums)

candidates.name: Instrument Serif
candidates.vercelRelation: WDA Vercel-ecosystem editorial standard paired with Geist & Instrument Sans
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Tall, narrow proportions keep 'Boca' compact around the slender bottle circumference so the full wordmark stays legible from a single hero angle without wrapping around the curvature.
candidates.pairingNotes: Natural sister family to Instrument Sans; razor-sharp terminals echo chilled sparkling mineral water.

candidates.name: Geist Serif
candidates.vercelRelation: Vercel's official high-contrast display serif in the Geist superfamily
candidates.editorialRole: Fashion-magazine display serif with unified Geist metrics
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Dramatic saw-toothed serifs and crisp downstrokes deliver unmistakable contemporary luxury along clear PET, echoing high-fashion print mastheads.
candidates.pairingNotes: Loads via jsDelivr @font-face (or npm i geist) with automatic Instrument Serif fallback.

candidates.name: Cormorant Garamond
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Sweeping, sculpted serifs and generous counters give the vertical wordmark an apothecary, Parisian mineral-water poise. Weight 500 holds hairline clarity over sparkling bubbles.
candidates.pairingNotes: Contrasts delicately against Instrument Sans's clean neo-grotesk geometry.

candidates.name: Newsreader
candidates.vercelRelation: Frequently co-deployed with Geist & Instrument Serif in WDA editorial builds
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Slightly sturdier hairlines than extreme Didones keep every letterform crisp even when viewed through curved liquid refraction and rising carbonation.
candidates.pairingNotes: Effortlessly bridges large display titles and refined editorial pull-quotes.

candidates.name: Fraunces
candidates.editorialRole: Sculptural soft-serif with warm coastal presence
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Rounded, tactile bowls in 'B', 'o', 'c', 'a' feel approachable and organic on a tall chilled bottle—more coastal hospitality than austere lab minimal.
candidates.pairingNotes: Pairs cleanly with Instrument Sans and Fragment Mono for a warm-luxury tone.

candidates.name: Bodoni Moda
candidates.verticalReadabilityRationale: Strict vertical stress and razor-thin crossbars turn the rotated '-90deg' wordmark into an architectural hairline signature running straight up the cylinder.
candidates.pairingNotes: Best at weight 500 on the bottle so hairlines stay luminous against dark studio lighting.
